answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonding each identity to a separately slashable escrow: when k coordinated identities equivocate on the same pulse, correlated evidence triggers penalties scaling as O(k^2), not merely k independent fines. Detection also compounds asymmetric capital depreciation across the swarm, so aggregate loss carries an exponential multiplier with swarm size; a vine of linked accounts cannot cheaply reach the summit of influence.
